<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Atelier Lumen — Architectural Design Studio</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Atelier Lumen is a high-end architectural design studio crafting sustainable, innovative spaces with material-centric warmth and modern precision." />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <!-- Serif for wordmark + geometric sans -->
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root{
      --bg-linen:#F4EFE7;
      --bg-stone:#EFE7DB;
      --paper:#FFFFFF;
      --charcoal:#141414;
      --charcoal-2:#1D1D1D;
      --muted:#6C6A66;
      --muted-2:#87837C;
      --line:rgba(20,20,20,.12);
      --shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      --shadow-2: 0 10px 26px rgba(20,20,20,.14);
      --radius-xl: 28px;
      --radius-lg: 22px;
      --radius-md: 16px;
      --radius-sm: 12px;

      --bronze-1:#D0A66B;
      --bronze-2:#B88A4C;
      --bronze-3:#8A5C2C;

      --accent:#D0A66B;
      --focus: rgba(208,166,107,.35);

      --container: 1180px;

      --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.2,1);
      --ease-soft: cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1);
      --speed: 260ms;
    }

    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html,body{height:100%}
    body{
      margin:0;
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      background:
        radial-gradient(1100px 700px at 25% -10%, rgba(208,166,107,.16), transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(900px 700px at 95% 15%, rgba(20,20,20,.06), transparent 55%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-stone) 0%, var(--bg-linen) 40%, #fff 120%);
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }

    a{color:inherit}
    .container{max-width:var(--container); margin:0 auto; padding:0 22px;}
    .sr-only{
      position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0;
    }

    /* --- Top floating nav (glassmorphism) --- */
    .topbar{
      position:sticky;
      top:14px;
      z-index:50;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .topbar .bar{
      pointer-events:auto;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:14px;
      padding:12px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.35);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(20,20,20,.12);
      transition: background var(--speed) var(--ease), border-color var(--speed) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--speed) var(--ease);
      max-width: var(--container);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .topbar.solid .bar{
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      border-color: rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgba(20,20,20,.16);
    }

    .brand{
      display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-width: 220px;
    }
    .mark{
      width:34px; height:34px; border-radius: 12px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(10px 12px at 65% 35%, rgba(255,255,255,.75), transparent 60%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze-1), var(--bronze-2) 55%, var(--bronze-3));
      box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(184,138,76,.22);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    .mark:after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute; inset:-12px -18px auto auto;
      width:56px; height:56px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.65), transparent 55%);
      transform: rotate(18deg);
      opacity:.75;
    }
    .wordmark{
      font-family: Fraunces, serif;
      letter-spacing: .2px;
      font-weight: 650;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height:1.05;
    }
    .wordmark span{
      display:block;
      font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .34em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .nav{
      display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    }
    .nav a, .nav button{
      position:relative;
      appearance:none;
      border:0;
      background:transparent;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition: background var(--speed) var(--ease), transform var(--speed) var(--ease);
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .nav a:hover, .nav button:hover{ background: rgba(20,20,20,.06); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .nav a:focus-visible, .nav button:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .caret{ margin-left: 6px; font-size: 11px; opacity: .65; }

    .dropdown{
      position:relative;
    }
    .menu{
      position:absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 10px);
      left: 0;
      width: 260px;
      padding: 10px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      opacity:0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(.98);
      pointer-events:none;
      transition: opacity var(--speed) var(--ease), transform var(--speed) var(--ease);
    }
    .dropdown[data-open="true"] .menu{
      opacity:1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
      pointer-events:auto;
    }
    .menu a{
      display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start;
      padding: 10px 10px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      text-decoration:none;
      transition: background var(--speed) var(--ease);
    }
    .menu a:hover{ background: rgba(208,166,107,.18); }
    .menu .mi{
      width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(20,20,20,.05);
      display:grid; place-items:center;
      border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.08);
      flex:none;
    }
    .menu .mt{ font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }
    .menu .md{ color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.25; margin-top: 2px;}

    /* CTA button */
    .cta{
      display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    }
    .btn{
      appearance:none; border:0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 11px 14px 11px 14px;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-weight: 650;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: .01em;
      display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
      text-decoration:none;
      transition: transform var(--speed) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--speed) var(--ease), background var(--speed) var(--ease);
      user-select:none;
    }
    .btn:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .btn-primary{
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze-1), var(--bronze-2));
      color: #15110a;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(184,138,76,.22);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(184,138,76,.25); }
    .btn-secondary{
      background: rgba(20,20,20,.92);
      color: white;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(20,20,20,.24);
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(20,20,20,.28);}
    .btn-ghost{
      background: transparent;
      border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.16);
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(20,20,20,.10); }
    .arrow{
      width: 12px; height: 12px;
      transition: transform var(--speed) var(--ease);
      display:inline-block;
    }
    .btn:hover .arrow{ transform: translateX(3px); }

    /* --- Sections / rhythm --- */
    section{
      padding: 92px 0;
      position:relative;
    }
    .band-linen{ background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(244,239,231,.86), rgba(244,239,231,.86)); }
    .band-white{ background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.92), rgba(255,255,255,.92)); }
    .band-contrast{
      background:
        radial-gradient(900px 500px at 15% 0%, rgba(208,166,107,.18), transparent 58%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #0f0f0f, #151515);
      color: #F5F2ED;
    }

    /* --- Hero --- */
    .hero{
      padding-top: 74px;
      padding-bottom: 72px;
    }
    .hero .wrap{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items:center;
      min-height: 68vh;
    }
    .kicker{
      display:inline-flex;
      gap:10px;
      align-items:center;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.5);
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(20,20,20,.08);
    }
    .dot{
      width: 8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze-1), var(--bronze-2));
      box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(184,138,76,.28);
    }
    h1{
      font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 72px);
      line-height: 1.02;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin: 18px 0 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .lead{
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--muted);
      max-width: 58ch;
      margin: 0 0 22px;
    }
    .hero-actions{
      display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }
    .meta-row{
      display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;
      margin-top: 26px;
      color: var(--muted-2);
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .meta-pill{
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
    }
    .hero-visual{
      position:relative;
      height: 520px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      background:
        radial-gradient(120px 120px at 18% 20%, rgba(208,166,107,.30), transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(140px 120px at 68% 36%, rgba(20,20,20,.08), transparent 60%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.75), rgba(255,255,255,.35));
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    .hero-visual .float{
      position:absolute;
      border-radius: 22px;
      overflow:hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgba(20,20,20,.12);
      background: #fff;
      transform: translateZ(0);
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .hero-visual .float img{
      width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;
      filter: saturate(1.03) contrast(1.02);
    }
    .float.a{ width: 62%; height: 62%; left: 8%; top: 12%; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
    .float.b{ width: 52%; height: 44%; right: -6%; top: 8%; transform: rotate(3deg); }
    .float.c{ width: 55%; height: 40%; left: 22%; bottom: 8%; transform: rotate(1deg); }
    .hero-visual .tag{
      position:absolute;
      left: 18px; bottom: 18px;
      background: rgba(20,20,20,.88);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 12px;
      display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    }
    .tag .chip{
      width: 22px; height:22px; border-radius:8px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze-1), var(--bronze-2));
      box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(184,138,76,.22);
    }

    /* --- Typography helpers --- */
    .eyebrow{
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: .26em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted-2);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .h2{
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.2vw, 44px);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .sub{
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 70ch;
    }

    /* --- Philosophy split --- */
    .split{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 26px;
      align-items:center;
    }
    .split.reverse{ grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 1fr; }
    .split.reverse .text{ order:2; }
    .split.reverse .visual{ order:1; }

    .card{
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    .text .inset{
      padding: 28px;
    }
    .bullets{
      display:grid;
      gap:10px;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }
    .bullet{
      display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .bullet .bicon{
      width: 18px; height:18px; border-radius:7px;
      background: rgba(208,166,107,.18);
      border:1px solid rgba(208,166,107,.32);
      flex:none;
      margin-top: 2px;
      position:relative;
    }
    .bullet .bicon:after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute; inset:4px;
      border-radius:5px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze-1), var(--bronze-2));
      opacity:.65;
    }

    .visual{
      position:relative;
      min-height: 420px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow:hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      background:
        radial-gradient(220px 180px at 10% 20%, rgba(208,166,107,.22), transparent 62%),
        radial-gradient(220px 180px at 80% 30%, rgba(20,20,20,.08), transparent 62%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.84), rgba(255,255,255,.34));
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }
    .visual .img{
      position:absolute; inset:0;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      filter: saturate(1.04) contrast(1.02);
      transform: scale(1.02);
      opacity:.92;
    }
    .visual .overlay-card{
      position:absolute;
      right: 16px;
      top: 16px;
      width: min(320px, calc(100% - 32px));
      background: rgba(20,20,20,.88);
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 16px 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 52px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
    }
    .overlay-card h4{
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      letter-spacing:.02em;
    }
    .chips{
      display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;
    }
    .chipx{
      padding: 7px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 12px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .visual .depth{
      position:absolute;
      left: 18px;
      bottom: 18px;
      display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
    .mini{
      width: 168px; height: 120px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow:hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(20,20,20,.16);
      background:#fff;
      transform: translateZ(0);
    }
    .mini img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }

    /* --- Testimonials (drag carousel) --- */
    .carousel{
      position:relative;
    }
    .track{
      display:flex;
      gap: 14px;
      overflow:auto;
      padding: 6px 6px 14px;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .track::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }
    .tcard{
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      flex: 0 0 min(420px, 84vw);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.86);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      overflow:hidden;
      transition: transform var(--speed) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--speed) var(--ease);
    }
    .tcard:hover{ transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(20,20,20,.14); }
    .tcard .top{
      display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center;
      padding: 18px 18px 14px;
    }
    .avatar{
      width: 56px; height:56px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow:hidden;
      border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      flex:none;
      background:#ddd;
    }
    .avatar img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
    .who{ min-width: 0; }
    .who .name{ font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
    .who .title{ color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 2px; }
    .tcard blockquote{
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0 18px 18px;
      color: var(--charcoal-2);
      line-height: 1.65;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .tcard .meta{
      padding: 0 18px 18px;
      color: var(--muted-2);
      font-size: 12px;
      display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    }
    .pill{
      padding: 7px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.10);
      background: rgba(244,239,231,.72);
    }
    .drag-indicator{
      position:absolute;
      right: 12px;
      top: -46px;
      opacity:0;
      transform: translateY(6px);
      pointer-events:none;
      transition: opacity var(--speed) var(--ease), transform var(--speed) var(--ease);
      display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;

Design, Build & Live in Harmony

Atelier Lumen designs residences, workplaces, and civic spaces where daylight, structure, and craft align. From early feasibility to construction oversight, we deliver calm, high-performance environments that age beautifully.

Schedule a Discovery Call View Portfolio

Design Philosophy
Material-led sustainability, engineered for delight.

Our process pairs editorial clarity with tactile experimentation—mockups, light studies, and iteration cycles that translate from concept to construction with minimal friction.

01
Sustainable

We treat sustainability as a design constraint that improves the experience: balanced daylight, low-toxicity finishes, durable details, and envelope performance that supports comfort across seasons.

Passive-first massing and operable shading tuned to climate data and occupancy patterns.
Material passports for stone, timber, and metalwork to support circular procurement.
Specification sets optimized for longevity: repairable assemblies and robust tolerances.

Philosophy Highlights

Biophilic principles Low-VOC interiors Daylight autonomy Thermal comfort modeling

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
import cv2,json
paths=sorted(Path('work/seconds').glob('*.png'))
prev=None
records=[]
for i,p in enumerate(paths):
    frame=cv2.imread(str(p)); info={'t':i+.5}
    if prev is not None:
        diff=cv2.absdiff(prev,frame).max(axis=2)
        _,binary=cv2.threshold(diff,45,255,cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
        contours,_=cv2.findContours(binary,cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
        boxes=[cv2.boundingRect(c) for c in contours]
        info['boxes']=[b for b in boxes if 8<=b[2]<=40 and 12<=b[3]<=40]
        info['change']=int((diff>45).sum())
    records.append(info);prev=frame
Path('work/diffs.json').write_text(json.dumps(records))
for start in range(0,len(paths),20):
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1912,5*263),'#ddd');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for j,p in enumerate(paths[start:start+20]):
        im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
        info=records[start+j]
        if info.get('change',999999)<2000:
            for x,y,w,h in info.get('boxes',[]):
                d.ellipse((x-25,y-25,x+w+25,y+h+25),outline='red',width=5)
        im=im.resize((478,239))
        x=(j%4)*478;y=(j//4)*263
        sheet.paste(im,(x,y+24)); draw.text((x+5,y+4),f'{start+j+.5:05.1f} sec',fill='black')
    sheet.save(f'work/sheets/sec{start//20+1}.jpg')
